title: Breakfast
description: Hannah French presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Saturday Morning
description: Tom Service talks to the trailblazing American conductor Marin Alsop about her musical life and why she's still up for the fight for equality, plus a deep dive into the Ocarina.

title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
description: Jools is joined by the composer Debbie Wiseman, with music by Messiaen, Chopin and Horovitz.

title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
description: 1871, Ohio. The songs of formerly enslaved people find a global audience.

title: Record Review
description: Andrew McGregor with the best new classical releases, joined by author & music critic Jessica Duchen, who surveys Schumann's 2nd Symphony and makes a top choice.

title: Sound of Cinema
description: This week, composer Simon Franglen discusses his soundtrack to Avatar: The Way of Water, and presenter Lorraine Kelly's reveals her Pick of the Flicks.

title: This Classical Life
description: Jess Gillam and composer and author Kerry Andrew share their favourite music, including pieces by Holst, Debussy and Mark Jenkin.

title: Opera on 3
description: Baritone Bernard Richter and soprano Sara Blanch star in Debussy's Pelléas et Mélisande with the chorus and opera of La Scala, Milan and conductor Maxime Pascal.

title: Music Planet
description: Guitarist, producer and composer Justin Adams takes the Music Planet reins for a personal journey through the world of folk and roots-based music.

title: New Music Show
description: Highlights from the opening concert of the Donaueschingen Festival and a new work from Hannah Kendall at London's Always Already There celebrations, presented by Tom Service.

title: Through the Night
description: Josep Pons conducts the BBC Symphony Orchestra in Bartók's The Miraculous Mandarin after pianist Beatrice Rana joins them for Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme of Paganini.

title: Breakfast
description: Mark Forrest presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Sunday Morning
description: Join Sarah Walker for the perfect Sunday playlist, including Korngold's Violin Concerto, a Choral Reflection from Spain, and a trip to the ballet in this week's Sunday Sequence.

title: Private Passions
description: Michael Berkeley's guest is the politician and journalist Michael Gove.

title: Music Map
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch explores Hildegard of Bingen's collection of sacred songs, the Symphonia Armoniae Celestium Revelationum - the Symphony and Harmony of Celestial Revelations.

title: Music Matters: The President and the Polka
description: Justin Webb (Today and Americast presenter) explores the surprising relationship between classical music and American political history.

title: Jazz Record Requests
description: Alyn Shipton looks ahead to some highlights at this year's London Jazz Festival along with some very special guest requesters.

title: The Early Music Show
description: Hannah French chats to Masato Suzuki, Principal Conductor of Bach Collegium Japan, pays tribute to trumpet player and maker David Staff, and explores a raft of new recordings.

title: Choral Evensong
description: Live from the Collegiate Church of St Mary, Warwick, with music by Elgar, Howells, Parry and Vaughan Williams.

title: Sunday Feature: At One with Sound - The Legacy of Hans Otte
description: Pianist Xenia Pestova Bennett marks Hans Otte's centenary - his Zen-infused piano music, Radio Bremen legacy and the man behind it.

title: Words and Music
description: As we mark Armistice, a playlist of poems by Rilke, Krishnamurti, Wordsworth and music by Hildegard of Bingen, Arvo Part, Haydn and Sibelius.

title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
description: Hannah meets a Young Composers' competition winner and plays the debut performance of Richard Blackford's first work for brass band.

title: Night Tracks
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.
